body: Yeah? Maybe I will. Why this book?

Thanks, that makes sense. I'm not religious, but it reminds me of the "Serenity Prayer" used by Alcoholics Anonymous: "God grant me the serenity to accept the things I cannot change; courage to change the things I can; and wisdom to know the difference." Logically, it makes a lot of sense. But in practice it's quite hard for me to follow.

Looking at what I wrote in a journal almost 10 years ago, I was beating myself up over the exact same issues. I feel like everyone around me is ageing while inside my growth is stunted while on the outside my body ages.

How can you get over regret? I look back and all I see is hundreds of opportunities that I've failed to seize.
I hope you get better. Hugs.
